title: The VGLC: The Video Game Level Corpus
authors: Adam James Summerville, Sam Snodgrass, Michael Mateas, Santiago Ontañón
core_method: Standardized text/graph benchmark corpus parsing human-designed classic video game levels.
key_quantitative_findings: Originally 9 tile maps and 18 graph maps for LoZ; expanded corpus holds 18 Zelda dungeons (9 dungeons x 2 quests, 10 tile symbols).
limitations_or_gaps: Extreme scarcity (~45 unique room interiors across 349 train rooms) and heavy cross-dungeon repetition.
relevance_to_glmdm: Primary dataset and empirical distribution ground truth (49.0% rooms contain BLOCK; 94.1% D9 interior overlap with D1-D8).

title: Generative Adversarial Network Rooms in Generative Graph Grammar Dungeons for The Legend of Zelda
authors: Jake Gutierrez, Jacob Schrum
core_method: Generates macro dungeon backbone via handcrafted graph grammar and populates fixed 16x11 rooms independently using DCGAN.
key_quantitative_findings: Evaluated via 30-subject human study on generated Graph+GAN dungeons.
limitations_or_gaps: GAN ignores global mission graph context; VGLC stripped down to 3 tiles (floor/wall/water), omitting keys/blocks/enemies.
relevance_to_glmdm: Direct predecessor motivating GraphGPS+RRWP room conditioning instead of unconditioned room GANs; strong external baseline.

title: Bootstrapping Conditional GANs for Video Game Level Generation
authors: Ruben Rodriguez Torrado, Ahmed Khalifa, Michael Cerny Green, Niels Justesen, Sebastian Risi, Julian Togelius
core_method: Conditional Self-Attention GAN bootstrapped iteratively using playable generated levels from heuristic A* filter.
key_quantitative_findings: Significantly increases playable ratio and reduces duplicate levels vs vanilla GAN.
limitations_or_gaps: Operates on single small rooms without multi-room lock-key dungeon topology.
relevance_to_glmdm: Early playability-filtered generative baseline contrasting differentiable LogicNet + multi-room graphs.
verification_source: Semantic Scholar / IEEE CoG (via web search)

title: Dungeon and Platformer Level Blending and Generation using Conditional VAEs
authors: Anurag Sarkar, Seth Cooper
core_method: Conditional VAE trained with horizontal/vertical flip augmentation to blend dungeon and platformer segments.
key_quantitative_findings: Expands VGLC Zelda unique room set via reflection symmetry up to 502 rooms (no holdout split).
limitations_or_gaps: Trained on whole corpus without holdout or multi-room progression graph guarantees.
relevance_to_glmdm: Supports reflection symmetry augmentation on top-down Zelda grids (extended in G-LMDM to lockstep V4 graph+mask equivariance).

title: Toward Co-creative Dungeon Generation via Transfer Learning
authors: Zisen Zhou, Matthew Guzdial
core_method: Deduplicates VGLC Zelda rooms and applies transfer learning on ~90/10 room-level split for co-creative editing.
key_quantitative_findings: Highlights that deduplicating repeated VGLC rooms is necessary to prevent biasing models toward dominant empty templates.
limitations_or_gaps: Single-room local editing without global key-lock progression solver.
relevance_to_glmdm: Supports deduplication/novelty tracking against unique VGLC rooms and explains empty-room bias.

title: Clustering-based Tile Embedding (CTE): A General Representation for Level Design with Skewed Tile Distributions
authors: Mrunal Jadhav, Matthew Guzdial
core_method: Clustering-based Tile Embedding (CTE) learning functional tile representations under heavily skewed tile frequencies.
key_quantitative_findings: Demonstrates greedy decoding on skewed tile distributions drops rare functional tiles in favor of background floor/air.
limitations_or_gaps: Addresses representation embedding rather than iterative discrete denoising or global graph solvability.
relevance_to_glmdm: Explains why BLOCK (8.61% of interior) collapsed without rare_tile_weight=2.0 and unbiased sampling.

title: Hybrid Encoding For Generating Large Scale Game Level Patterns With Local Variations
authors: Jacob Schrum, Benjamin Capps, Kirby Steckel, Vanessa Volz, Sebastian Risi
core_method: CPPNThenDirect2GAN combines indirect CPPN patterns with direct latent-vector evolution over pretrained GAN rooms.
key_quantitative_findings: Deduplicating repeated VGLC Zelda interiors collapses training corpus to ~38 unique room templates.
limitations_or_gaps: CPPN bias creates excessive repetition; GAN trained separately rather than end-to-end with global validity discriminators.
relevance_to_glmdm: Documents extreme VGLC Zelda template scarcity (~38-45 unique layouts) and memorization risks.

title: Game Level Blending using a Learned Level Representation
authors: Venkata Sai Revanth Atmakuri, Seth Cooper, Matthew Guzdial
core_method: Learns shared level representation across 459 undeduplicated Zelda rooms and Lode Runner using 85/10/5 random split.
key_quantitative_findings: Evaluates cross-game blending quality on random room split.
limitations_or_gaps: Random room-level split on undeduplicated VGLC rooms leaks identical templates across train and test.
relevance_to_glmdm: Illustrates exact leakage pitfall avoided by G-LMDM dungeon-grouped K-fold CV and V4 novelty audit.

title: Active Learning for Classifying 2D Grid-Based Level Completability
authors: Mahsa Bazzaz, Seth Cooper
core_method: Active learning with CNN classifiers on 1,508 synthetic VGDL Zelda levels (20% test + 5-fold CV) to predict level completability.
key_quantitative_findings: Achieves strong F1 on synthetic Zelda, though neural surrogates exhibit higher False Discovery Rate than False Omission Rate.
limitations_or_gaps: Active loop slow (7 min vs 3s passive); neural completability classifiers are still fallible proxies needing exact verification.
relevance_to_glmdm: Justifies using StateSpaceAStar for final certification while keeping LogicNet strictly as a training regularizer.

title: The Five-Dollar Model: Generating Game Maps and Sprites from Sentence Embeddings
authors: Timothy Merino, Roman Negri, Dipika Rajesh, M Charity, Julian Togelius
core_method: Ultra-lightweight MLP mapping CLIP sentence embeddings directly to low-res discrete maps/sprites on small data.
key_quantitative_findings: Shows parameter-frugal generators remain competitive on tiny categorical game corpora; naive RGB augmentations fail.
limitations_or_gaps: Low zero-shot OOD generalization; no topological graph conditioning or solvability proof.
relevance_to_glmdm: Supports G-LMDM compact denoiser budget (77K params) and domain-aware V4 equivariant augmentation.

title: Procedural Content Generation via Knowledge Transformation (PCG-KT)
authors: Anurag Sarkar, Seth Cooper, Matthew Guzdial
core_method: Cross-game latent representations evaluated with post-hoc A* reachability agents.
key_quantitative_findings: Discrete self-contained Zelda rooms are poorly represented in equal-weight continuous blends with open Metroid maps.
limitations_or_gaps: Relies on post-hoc A* checks rather than in-loop constraints or playable blended mechanics.
relevance_to_glmdm: Shows structural uniqueness of Zelda 2-tile-walled rooms and limits of post-hoc reachability filtering.

title: Multiverse: Language-Conditioned Multi-Game Level Blending via Shared Representation
authors: In-Chang Baek, Jiyun Jung, Geum-Hwan Hwang, Sung-Hyun Kim, Kyung-Joong Kim
dataset_or_domain: VGLC Zelda + Dungeon + Mario + Lode Runner
core_method: Shared text-conditioned level representation trained with rotation + horizontal flip augmentation on 80/20 split.
key_quantitative_findings: Suffers ~4.4% drop vs single-game models (Zelda metric drops 0.767 -> 0.719) and weak compositional adherence.
limitations_or_gaps: Single 80/20 split without dungeon-grouped CV; weak global progression constraints.
relevance_to_glmdm: Shows single-domain graph conditioning avoids cross-game interference while confirming rotation/flip augmentation norm on Zelda.

title: PCGRL: Procedural Content Generation via Reinforcement Learning
authors: Ahmed Khalifa, Philip Bontrager, Sam Earle, Julian Togelius
core_method: Sequential tile-editing MDP with Narrow, Turtle, and Wide representations trained via PPO (100M frames).
key_quantitative_findings: Reaches 86.7% (Narrow), 88.3% (Turtle), 67.5% (Wide) single-room Zelda solvability at 100% inference edit budget.
limitations_or_gaps: Requires 100M frames RL training; high edit budgets cause mode collapse; does not learn VGLC corpus styles or multi-room graphs.
relevance_to_glmdm: Balanced competing paradigm: optimizes global playability directly via RL without datasets, contrasting G-LMDM 8-step corpus-faithful synthesis.

title: Learning Controllable Content Generators
authors: Sam Earle, Maria Edwards, Ahmed Khalifa, Philip Bontrager, Julian Togelius
core_method: Conditions PCGRL PPO policies on continuous target metrics (path length, nearest-enemy distance) with shaped rewards.
key_quantitative_findings: Controls Zelda path length and enemy distance dynamically mid-episode while maintaining Hamming diversity.
limitations_or_gaps: Struggles with conflicting targets; tends toward repetitive winding corridors when maximizing path length.
relevance_to_glmdm: Counterpart for controllable generation via continuous scalar goals vs G-LMDM structural mission-graph conditioning.

title: Controllable Path of Destruction
authors: Matthew Siper, Sam Earle, Zehua Jiang, Ahmed Khalifa, Julian Togelius
core_method: Corrupts 50 valid Zelda levels into 962,500 sequential state-action repair steps with signed control targets.
key_quantitative_findings: Demonstrates high data efficiency from just 50 levels on path-length control, though fails to control enemy count.
limitations_or_gaps: Sequential single-tile editing instead of parallel global masked denoising; lacks multi-room mission conditioning.
relevance_to_glmdm: Close conceptual bridge between iterative repair and discrete masked diffusion on small Zelda data.

title: PCGRL+: Scaling, Control and Generalization in Reinforcement Learning Level Generators
authors: Sam Earle, Zehua Jiang, Julian Togelius
core_method: Vectorized JAX PCGRL evaluating egocentric observation windows (3x3 to 31x31) across randomized OOD map sizes.
key_quantitative_findings: >15x training speedup (~11k FPS); size-3 local obs beats global 31x31 on OOD 32x32 dungeons (548.01 vs 492.11 reward).
limitations_or_gaps: Sequential tile-edit episodes with expensive per-step shortest-path reward calls; lacks VGLC mission-graph grammar.
relevance_to_glmdm: Important modern PCGRL benchmark illustrating overfitting of absolute coordinate features on OOD maps.

title: Video Game Level Design as a Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Problem
authors: Sam Earle, Zehua Jiang, Eugene Vinitsky, Julian Togelius
core_method: Multiple local-patch agents edit shared dungeon grids under amortized O(N^2) pathfinding reward schedules.
key_quantitative_findings: 3 agents slightly trail 1 agent in-distribution (44.49 vs 46.33) but beat 1 agent on OOD 32x32 maps (41.52 vs 15.69).
limitations_or_gaps: Edit-conflict overhead and reward-engineering dependency without generative corpus modeling.
relevance_to_glmdm: Represents latest RL PCG scaling; highlights trade-off between handcrafted RL rewards and corpus-trained MDM priors.

title: Adventures in level design: generating missions and spaces for action adventure games
authors: Joris Dormans
core_method: Decouples lock-and-key mission graph rewriting from 2D spatial layout shape grammars.
key_quantitative_findings: Demonstrates structured non-linear key-lock progression via mission-space decoupling.
limitations_or_gaps: Hand-authored rewrite rules; cannot learn visual/geometric room distributions from VGLC corpora.
relevance_to_glmdm: Foundational neuro-symbolic division of labor adopted by Block I (Mission Grammar) + Block IV (Neural Room Model).

title: Answer Set Programming for Procedural Content Generation: A Design Space Approach
authors: Adam M. Smith, Michael Mateas
core_method: Declaratively specifies valid dungeon reachability and structural invariants via ASP solvers.
key_quantitative_findings: Fast single-grid solving with formal satisfaction guarantees whenever rules are consistent.
limitations_or_gaps: Manual rule formalization; lacks learned continuous/corpus style priors; grounding overhead on complex multi-room mechanics.
relevance_to_glmdm: Fast single-room symbolic counter-example balancing claims about constraint-solver speed.

title: WaveFunctionCollapse is constraint solving in the wild
authors: Isaac Karth, Adam M. Smith
core_method: Formalizes WaveFunctionCollapse as arc-consistency constraint propagation over local NxN patterns.
key_quantitative_findings: Achieves fast, example-driven local coherence from single maps.
limitations_or_gaps: Contradictions without backtracking; strictly local rules miss global progression constraints.
relevance_to_glmdm: Clarifies why purely local WFC pattern synthesis complements but cannot replace global dungeon logic.

title: Sturgeon: Tile-Based Procedural Level Generation via Learned and Designed Constraints
authors: Seth Cooper
core_method: Encodes column-stride n-grams learned from 1 level with SAT/MIP reachability constraints.
key_quantitative_findings: Guarantees single-goal maze reachability; 14x18 Mario repair takes 10.5m median / 24.8m max (7/36 bins timed out).
limitations_or_gaps: Explicitly lists lock-and-key mechanics, multi-goal progression, and repair scaling as open work.
relevance_to_glmdm: Motivates decoupling NP-complete global lock-key solving from neural local room synthesis.

title: WaveFunctionCollapse: Content Generation via Constraint Solving and Machine Learning
authors: Isaac Karth, Adam M. Smith
core_method: Extends WFC analysis with backtracking, heuristics, and ASP solver comparisons.
key_quantitative_findings: Quantifies contradiction vs search-heuristic trade-offs across single-example tile synthesis.
limitations_or_gaps: Global progression constraints (keys/locks) remain outside local pattern extraction.
relevance_to_glmdm: Benchmark symbolic local-pattern baseline (also present in repo baselines).

title: Sturgeon-MKIV: Constraint-Based Level and Playthrough Generation with Graph Label Rewrite Rules
authors: Seth Cooper, Mahsa Bazzaz
core_method: Encodes Dormans graph rewrite rules + simultaneous playthrough proofs inside SAT/constraint solver.
key_quantitative_findings: Adding mechanic playthrough checks jumps median solve time ~100x from 6.07s (graph-only) to 585.38s median / 1625.65s max.
limitations_or_gaps: Graphs still require processing into real spatial rooms with placed keys/locks; 585-1625s prohibitive for interactive use.
relevance_to_glmdm: Exact evidence of combinatorial bottleneck when pure SAT unifies mission+playthrough without neural room synthesis.

title: Evolutionary Wave Function Collapse
authors: Dipika Rajesh, Ahmed Khalifa, Julian Togelius
core_method: Evolves compact input pattern grids for WFC to improve maze/dungeon structure.
key_quantitative_findings: Succeeds on local maze connectivity but fails on Zelda global constraints (unique player/key/door ordering).
limitations_or_gaps: Local WFC adjacency patterns cannot express non-local progression constraints without external solver integration.
relevance_to_glmdm: Directly confirms necessity of hybrid symbolic + neural architecture for Zelda lock-key synthesis.

title: MarioGPT: Open-Ended Text2Level Generation through Large Language Models
authors: Shyam Sudhakaran, Miguel González-Duque, Claire Glanois, Matthias Freiberger, Elias Najarro, Sebastian Risi
core_method: Fine-tunes distilled GPT-2 with frozen text cross-attention to generate Mario columns + path left-to-right.
key_quantitative_findings: 93% tile / 91% path accuracy; 88.4% A*-playable; drops to 68% accuracy on rare enemy tokens.
limitations_or_gaps: Fixed 1D left-to-right column serialization ill-suited to 2D 4-boundary room sockets; weak rare-tile prompt adherence.
relevance_to_glmdm: Key AR Transformer comparator demonstrating boundary-socket mismatch of causal 1D scanning on 2D Zelda rooms.

title: Level Generation Through Large Language Models
authors: Graham Todd, Sam Earle, Muhammad Umair Nasir, Michael Cerny Green, Julian Togelius
core_method: Fine-tunes GPT-2/GPT-3 on serialized 2D Sokoban text grids with density/solution-length prefixes.
key_quantitative_findings: GPT-2 achieves 0.54 playability on large Boxoban (collapses to 0.02-0.04 on small Microban) and fails global solution_len control (0.17 acc).
limitations_or_gaps: Data-hungry on small grids; causal next-token prediction fails global planning invariants.
relevance_to_glmdm: Direct empirical evidence of AR collapse on small 2D puzzle datasets when global planning length is constrained.

title: Train for the Worst, Plan for the Best: Understanding Token Ordering in Masked Diffusions
authors: Jaeyeon Kim, Kulin Shah, Vasilis Kontonis, Sham Kakade, Sitan Chen
core_method: Analyzes random vs adaptive Top-K probability-margin unmasking orders in Masked Diffusion Models.
key_quantitative_findings: 6M MDM with Top-K margin hits 89.49% on Sudoku (vs 6.88% vanilla, 18.51% Top-K prob, 9.73% 42M AR).
limitations_or_gaps: Margin heuristics improve puzzle orderings where constraints are uniform, whereas skewed grids risk majority lock-in.
relevance_to_glmdm: Clarifies sensitivity of MDM to unmasking schedule; motivates contrasting confidence vs uniform random unmasking on Zelda.

title: Beyond Autoregression: Discrete Diffusion for Complex Reasoning and Planning
authors: Jiacheng Ye, Jiahui Gao, Shansan Gong, Lin Zheng, Xin Jiang, Zhenguo Li, Lingpeng Kong
core_method: Multi-Granularity Diffusion Modeling (MGDM) with token/sequence reweighting and easy-first decoding.
key_quantitative_findings: 100% vs 20.7% AR on Sudoku; 91.5% vs 45.8-51.1% AR on Countdown-4; 1-step MGDM beats AR at 10x speed.
limitations_or_gaps: No explicit hard constraint verifier during training or sampling.
relevance_to_glmdm: Establishes theoretical/empirical superiority of bidirectional discrete diffusion over causal AR on combinatorial planning.

title: Search-Augmented Masked Diffusion Models for Constrained Generation
authors: Huu Binh Ta, Michael Cardei, Alvaro Velasquez, Ferdinando Fioretto
core_method: Training-free Candidate Search Sampling + Hamming-1 local search guided by black-box verifiers at each denoising step.
key_quantitative_findings: Sudoku: 96.5% vs 93.2% MDM, 92.2% post-hoc repair, 23-31% AR; 3-SAT: boosts MDM 9.6% -> 76.0%.
limitations_or_gaps: Incurs per-step black-box search calls at inference; tested on 1D sequences/logic puzzles rather than 2D room graphs.
relevance_to_glmdm: Contrasts test-time search MDM against G-LMDM train-time amortized LogicNet + minimal post-hoc StateSpaceAStar.

title: MaskGIT: Masked Generative Image Transformer
authors: Huiwen Chang, Han Zhang, Lu Jiang, Ce Liu, William T. Freeman
core_method: Bidirectional masked token transformer trained with cosine masking schedule and iterative confidence-based decoding.
key_quantitative_findings: Generates discrete grids in 8 steps at up to 64x speedup over autoregressive transformers.
limitations_or_gaps: Confidence-ranked unmasking acts implicitly as low-temperature sampling and locks in early mistakes.
relevance_to_glmdm: Architectural backbone of Block IV (8-step discrete masked transformer with cosine schedule).

title: Constrained Synthesis with Projected Diffusion Models
authors: Jacob K. Christopher, Stephen Baek, Ferdinando Fioretto
dataset_or_domain: Materials, Physics Motion, Trajectories, 3D Human Motion
core_method: Recasts SGLD reverse diffusion as constrained optimization projecting iterates onto feasible sets at every denoising step.
key_quantitative_findings: Outperforms Cond, Cond+, and Post+ on constraint satisfaction and FID; Reviewers raised compute cost, FID misuse, and noise-level mismatch.
limitations_or_gaps: Per-step QP/DP solver overhead; convex convergence proofs; direct projection at noisy steps shifts off training noise schedule.
relevance_to_glmdm: Directly motivates G-LMDM amortized train-time LogicNet with (1-m)^2 mask gating (0 ms inference overhead) + domain metrics.

title: Simple and Effective Masked Diffusion Language Models
authors: Subham Sekhar Sahoo, Marianne Arriola, Yair Schiff, Aaron Gokaslan, Edgar Marroquin, Justin T Chiu, Alexander Rush, Volodymyr Kuleshov
core_method: Derives Rao-Blackwellized absorbing masked diffusion objective reducing to time-weighted masked token cross-entropy.
key_quantitative_findings: Closes perplexity gap to AR while supporting flexible unmasking and semi-autoregressive generation.
limitations_or_gaps: Standard absorbing state cannot uncommit/remask erroneous tokens once decoded.
relevance_to_glmdm: Underpins uniform unmasking theory and motivates G-LMDM corrector remasking round.

title: Simplified and Generalized Masked Diffusion for Discrete Data
authors: Jiaxin Shi, Kehang Han, Zhe Wang, Arnaud Doucet, Michalis K. Titsias
core_method: Simplified continuous-time absorbing-state discrete diffusion objective expressed as weighted cross-entropy.
key_quantitative_findings: Achieves SOTA discrete likelihood among diffusion models with simple Rao-Blackwellized masked CE objective.
limitations_or_gaps: Uniformly unweighted combinatorial guarantees; no built-in topological/path solvability coupling.
relevance_to_glmdm: Theoretical foundation for weighted masked CE and time/mask-ratio ELBO weighting in G-LMDM.

title: Neuro-Symbolic Generative Diffusion Models for Physically Grounded, Robust, and Safe Generation
authors: Jacob K. Christopher, Michael Cardei, Jinhao Liang, Ferdinando Fioretto
core_method: Extends NeurIPS 2024 Projected Diffusion Models (PDM) comparing Cond, Cond+, and Post+ against per-step feasible projection.
key_quantitative_findings: Demonstrates post-hoc projection degrades sample quality/FID sharply, while step-wise projection incurs runtime cost.
limitations_or_gaps: Focused on continuous manifolds and convex guarantees; discrete combinatorial projection only sketched.
relevance_to_glmdm: Supplies exact Cond / Cond+ / Post+ baseline framing adopted by G-LMDM Schema 2.0 + JS distribution shift.

title: Demystifying MaskGIT Sampler and Beyond: Adaptive Order Selection in Masked Diffusion
authors: Satoshi Hayakawa, Yuhta Takida, Masaaki Imaizumi, Hiromi Wakaki, Yuki Mitsufuji
core_method: Proves MaskGIT confidence top-k acts implicitly as low-temperature sampling; proposes Choose-Then-Sample (CTS) moment sampler.
key_quantitative_findings: Decoupling position selection from categorical sampling restores sample diversity at high step counts.
limitations_or_gaps: Unconstrained likelihood matching without topological/combinatorial invariants.
relevance_to_glmdm: Explains why confidence-ranked unmasking collapsed BLOCK to 0 even after raising token temperature.

title: Improving Classifier-Free Guidance in Masked Diffusion: Low-Dim Theoretical Insights with High-Dim Impact
authors: Kevin Rojas, Ye He, Chieh-Hsin Lai, Yuhta Takida, Yuki Mitsufuji, Molei Tao
core_method: Analyzes Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) normalization failures in masked diffusion causing rapid early unmasking.
key_quantitative_findings: High CFG weight w>1 collapses non-dominant features unless transition columns are normalized and ramped up late.
limitations_or_gaps: Requires trained unconditional dropout baseline and rate normalization.
relevance_to_glmdm: Explains why naive guidance_scale=3.0 without unconditional dropout is invalid in discrete_masked mode (fixed to 1.0).

title: Remasking Discrete Diffusion Models with Inference-Time Scaling
authors: Guanghan Wang, Yair Schiff, Subham Sekhar Sahoo, Volodymyr Kuleshov
core_method: Adds principled remasking transition kernel at inference time so absorbed discrete diffusion can revise committed tokens.
key_quantitative_findings: Overcomes failure-to-remask bottleneck, consistently improving generation validity with inference compute scaling.
limitations_or_gaps: Not yet bridged to 2D spatial/topological game-level constraints or mission graphs.
relevance_to_glmdm: Supports corrector remasking rounds in DiscreteMaskedRoomModel.sample.

title: Solvable Sokoban Without a Solver via Diffusion
authors: Sina Baghal
core_method: Trains MD4 with factorized 2D row+col embeddings, capped ELBO weights (w_max=10), and uniform random unmasking at T=1.0.
key_quantitative_findings: Confidence unmasking inflates walls 69.5->81.5%; T=0.6 cuts puzzle difficulty 36%. Loss converges early while solvability climbs +25 pts (77.4% raw, 98.7% 1-wall repair).
limitations_or_gaps: Trained on huge synthetic Sokoban corpus; no graph-level lock-key conditioning or differentiable solvability regularizer.
relevance_to_glmdm: Core empirical proof of loss-solvability decoupling, confidence-unmasking wall inflation, and uniform random unmasking fix.

title: Constrained Code Generation with Discrete Diffusion
authors: Lize Shao, Michael Cardei, Zichen Xie, Ferdinando Fioretto, Wenxi Wang
core_method: Integrates intermediate static-analyzer violation feedback and localized remasking during discrete denoising.
key_quantitative_findings: Cuts edit footprint from 98-123 tokens (post-hoc regeneration) to 12-35 localized edits.
limitations_or_gaps: Evaluated on 1D code ASTs rather than 2D dungeon spatial grids.
relevance_to_glmdm: Supports tracking minimal edit footprint (tiles_repaired_mean) and localized symbolic correction.

title: Discrete Diffusion Playground: A 2D Benchmark for Discrete Generative Models
authors: Justin Shao, Sihyun Park, David Ryan Koes, Maria Chikina
core_method: Benchmarks MD4, MDLM, SEDD, ReMDM using Total Variation and reverse KL against cell-wise MSE.
key_quantitative_findings: Masked models learn coarse-to-fine reveal orders yet leak mass onto invalid cells; denoising loss fails to expose TV/KL drift.
limitations_or_gaps: Synthetic 2D distributions without multi-room mission topology.
relevance_to_glmdm: Directly motivates reporting TV and JS-divergence on interior tile distributions alongside cross-entropy.

title: Where Generated Floor Plans Stop: Calibrated Sample-Level Checks Against a Built Baseline
authors: Yiliang Shao
core_method: Audits House-GAN, House-GAN++, HouseDiffusion, and GSDiff with calibrated sample-level layout checks.
key_quantitative_findings: Graph-adjacency compatibility saturates and fails to predict spatial validity (ROC AUC 0.43-0.53); diffusion leaders fail geometric checks most often.
limitations_or_gaps: Focuses on architectural floor plans rather than lock-key gameplay traversal.
relevance_to_glmdm: Validates G-LMDM separation of graph compatibility vs true tile-state A* solvability and Schema 2.0 attribution.

title: Value Iteration Networks
authors: Aviv Tamar, Yi Wu, Garrett Thomas, Sergey Levine, Pieter Abbeel
core_method: Unrolls K weight-tied differentiable 3x3 Bellman backup + max layers inside a neural policy.
key_quantitative_findings: 99.6%->97.0% success on 8x8..28x28 grids vs CNNs dropping 97.9%->74.2%; weight sharing aids low-data generalization.
limitations_or_gaps: Fixed local grid MDP; lacks arbitrary mission-graph lifting or consumable key-lock state gates.
relevance_to_glmdm: Historical foundation for Block V soft Bellman-Ford pathfinding regularizer.

title: Differentiation of Blackbox Combinatorial Solvers
authors: Marin Vlastelica, Anselm Paulus, Vít Musil, Georg Martius, Michal Rolínek
core_method: Continuous piecewise-affine interpolation through blackbox solvers using perturbed costs for exact backward gradients.
key_quantitative_findings: 94-96% optimal-cost test paths on Warcraft maps (vs 0-23% ResNet18) and 96.7% TSP tours.
limitations_or_gaps: Restricted to linear objectives and doubles solver runtime calls during training.
relevance_to_glmdm: Alternative paradigm to soft Bellman-Ford relaxation in LogicNet for end-to-end path supervision.

title: Recipe for a General, Powerful, Scalable Graph Transformer
authors: Ladislav Rampášek, Mikhail Galkin, Vijay Prakash Dwivedi, Anh Tuan Luu, Guy Wolf, Dominique Beaini
core_method: Combines local message passing (GINE/GatedGCN) with global Transformer attention and positional/structural encodings.
key_quantitative_findings: SOTA on ZINC (0.070 MAE); ablating MPNN degrades MAE to 0.217; scales up to 5,000-node graphs.
limitations_or_gaps: O(N^2) global attention cost and sensitivity to PE choice across tasks.
relevance_to_glmdm: Core mission-graph encoder architecture in Block III condition_encoder (2-layer GraphGPS).

title: Graph Inductive Biases in Transformers without Message Passing
authors: Liheng Ma, Chen Lin, Derek Lim, Adriana Romero-Soriano, Puneet K. Dokania, Mark Coates, Philip Torr, Ser-Nam Lim
core_method: Encodes Relative Random Walk Probabilities (RRWP) edge biases to express shortest-path distances and multi-hop dependencies.
key_quantitative_findings: Outperforms GraphGPS on ZINC (0.059 vs 0.070 MAE) and Peptides-func (0.6988 vs 0.6535 AP).
limitations_or_gaps: O(N^2) pair representation cost on very large graphs (negligible on 10-30 room Zelda graphs).
relevance_to_glmdm: Supplies condition_use_rrwp_edge_features in Block III to capture key-before-lock topological distances.
